output.reason: [ev-f0029965e392] says istio-csr is broken by Istio 1.24's stricter gRPC validation and that no released istio-csr version has the fix yet ("v0.12.0 does not have the fix"). No source names v0.12.1 or any other fixed version, so the proposed range ">=0.12.1" is made up. The known affected range is released istio-csr up to and including 0.12.0. [ev-6ce6d5181b3b] and [ev-f73f0bc25f75] name the workaround GRPC_ENFORCE_ALPN_ENABLED=false, so environments that set it are shielded and belong in overlap, not exposure.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds stricter ALPN validation to its internal gRPC calls to the control plane. This breaks cert-manager istio-csr releases up to v0.12.0, which lack the upstream fix, with 'missing selected ALPN property' handshake errors. Setting GRPC_ENFORCE_ALPN_ENABLED=false avoids the failure.
